sentences.en: At present, most studies are focused on dissolved phosphorus concentrations and distributions in our country, and little is known about the suspended paniculate phosphorus and the phosphorus dynamics.

sentences.en: In this paper, we compare the activities and isozymes of peroxidase and esterase between the normal and vitrified shoots of Gypsophila paniculate .
